body_markdown:
09/30/26


Simpson Strong-Tie Expands into Everyday Anchoring with New Sure Wall™ Anchor Line


PLEASANTON, Calif. — Everyday anchoring projects now have a stronger, simpler option with the introduction of Sure Wall™ anchors from Simpson Strong-Tie. The portfolio gives homeowners, DIYers and professionals anchor options engineered for common mounting, hanging and installation projects while bringing the trusted Simpson Strong-Tie name to everyday home repair.


Designed for drywall, concrete, masonry and hollow block, Sure Wall anchors help homeowners approach common mounting, hanging and installation projects with greater confidence. The portfolio brings the engineering mindset, dependable performance and jobsite trust Simpson Strong-Tie has built with construction professionals into the home-improvement aisle. With solutions for lightweight, medium-duty and heavier-duty applications, users can more easily match the anchor to the wall material and project — from picture frames, mirrors and shelving to lighting fixtures, mounted televisions, plumbing components and HVAC installations.


The lineup combines easy-to-understand choices with installation-friendly designs that deliver dependable holding power. Self-drilling, expansion and toggle options support a range of wall materials and load needs, while many projects can be completed with common household tools instead of specialized equipment. The result is a more straightforward path from choosing an anchor to completing the job securely.


“Professionals have trusted Simpson Strong-Tie for decades when strength and reliability matter,” said, Simpson Strong-Tie Product Manager Dominic Savoldelli. “Sure Wall extends that same confidence to homeowners, giving them dependable, easy-to-select solutions for everyday projects throughout the home.”


Available in a variety of styles, sizes and finishes, the Sure Wall family gives users a purpose-built option for the wall material, installation method and level of support their project requires:


· Sure Wall X1 Plug Anchor: A versatile plug anchor for common anchoring in drywall, concrete, masonry and other hollow and solid base materials.


· TU Plug Anchor: A winged nylon plug for everyday anchoring into drywall, concrete and masonry.


· Self-Drilling Drywall Anchor: A straightforward option for mounting lightweight items in drywall, often using only a screwdriver.


· Hollow-Wall Anchor: Designed to expand behind drywall or other hollow wall materials for a secure hold.


· Hollow-Wall Drive Anchor: A drive-style solution for faster installation in hollow walls.


· Spring Toggle: Provides broad support behind hollow walls for fixtures that require greater holding capacity.


· Self-Drilling Toggle Anchor: Combines self-drilling installation with toggle action behind drywall for added support.


· Self-Drilling Strap Toggle: A heavier-duty hollow-wall option for securely mounting larger fixtures.


For more information, visit Sure Wall™ Anchoring Solutions | Simpson Strong-Tie or contact a local Simpson Strong-Tie representative.


About Simpson Strong-Tie


Simpson Strong-Tie is the world leader in structural solutions — products and technology that help people design and build safer, stronger homes, buildings and communities. As a pioneer in the building industry, we have an unmatched passion for problem solving through skilled engineering and thoughtful innovation. Our structural systems research and rigorous testing enable us to design code-listed, value-engineered solutions for a variety of applications in wood, steel and concrete structures. Our dedication to pursuing ever-better construction products and technology and to surrounding our customers with exceptional service and support has been core to our mission since 1956. For more information, visit strongtie.com and follow us on Facebook, YouTube and LinkedIn.
